Šéf estonské diplomacie uvedl, že o rozhodnutí Tallinnu informoval své protějšky ve Finsku, Lotyšsku a Litvě. Moskva se k věci zatím nevyjádřila.

Pohyb ruské sabotážní skupiny Černí Rusové byl důvodem rozsáhlé operace polských bezpečnostních sil u hranic s ruskou Kaliningradskou oblastí. Uvedl to polský veřejnoprávní rozhlas Polskie Radio 24. Varšava na severovýchodě svého území zřídila speciální jednotku. Reagovala tak na varování rozvědky před možnými ruskými sabotážemi a vpády přes hranice.
Foto: Kuba Stezycki, Reuters
Polští vojáci z 18. mechanizované divize hlídají polskou hranici s Běloruskem
Článek
„V reakci na hrozbu sabotáží posílily polské bezpečnostní složky ochranu hranic,“ vysvětlila stanice přesuny na polské straně hranice s ruskou Kaliningradskou oblastí. Velení polských bezpečnostních sil vyslalo do Podlaského a Varmijsko-mazurského vojvodství posily, včetně příslušníků polské speciální jednotky GROM, dalších příslušníků pohraniční stráže a policejních protiteroristických jednotek.
Podle polského premiéra Donalda Tuska se posily aktivovaly, když pohraničníci v noci na úterý zaznamenali…

Source: a press release by the Norwegian government, as reported by European Pravda
Details: The Norwegian Air Force is deploying specialised NASAMS sensors, while the military garrison in the region will be reinforced by more than 30 soldiers.

The sensors are designed to detect drones, warn of their presence and provide a comprehensive picture of all activity in the airspace over border areas.

Polish police have launched a special operation to secure the area along the border with the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad after receiving information that acts of sabotage may take place there in the coming days.

Estonia to close Russia border after 'sabotage' bid
AFP
Published: 15.11.26 17:38 , Update: 15.11.26 17:50
'We will not be intimidated,' said Prime Minister Kristen Michal
© AFP
Estonia said Sunday it would close its border with Russia after stopping what it said was an attempted arson attack by Russia's GRU military intelligence on a drone factory.
"Estonia will close all Estonian-Russian border crossing points as of 1 December," Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna posted on X, citing "clear evidence" that the GRU had ordered the attack.
Earlier Sunday, Prime Minister Kristen Michal wrote on X that the GRU had ordered a "sabotage attempt" at the Estonian defence company Threod Systems on Saturday night.
"Extensive damage was averted thanks to heightened security measures and a swift reaction by law enforcement. The attackers have been detained," he added.

Secretly enter homes
Carry out cyberattacks on foreign IT systems
Delete or alter data or redirect internet traffic
Use AI to analyze biometric data
Recruit teenagers 16 and older as informants in exceptional cases
A special body, including former judges, will review whether proposed measures are legal before the agencies carry them out.

Four people were killed in a Ukrainian drone attack on an industrial facility in the Samara region on the morning of November 13, Samara Governor Vyacheslav Fedorishchev said.
There were also injuries, and the victims are receiving medical care, Fedorishchev said, without specifying how many were wounded.
Fedorishchev did not say which facility was struck. The Ukrainian monitoring channel Exilenova+ wrote that the target was the Samara linear production and dispatching station (LPDS).
The Samara linear production and dispatching station (LPDS) is a major oil infrastructure facility where oil from Tatarstan, Western Siberia, and other oil-producing regions of Russia is stored and pumped.
The station regularly becomes a target of Ukrainian strikes, the independent Telegram channel Astra notes. In October, the facility was attacked at least four times.

Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten was to hold crisis talks with key partners Friday in a last-ditch bid to save his minority coalition government from collapse only nine months after taking power.
An unseemly political row over tax policy has raised the spectre of snap elections in the European Union's fifth-largest economy and weakened the centrist Jetten, the country's youngest-ever prime minister.
Since winning a razor-thin election, Jetten's D66 party has been in an uneasy three-way coalition with the centre-right CDA and the right-wing VVD.

ROME – The intelligence services had warned days earlier that, after aircraft, schools could be the next targets. Politicians have been debating the issue for years. Twelve months ago, Defence Minister Guido Crosetto unveiled a plan setting out the structures, powers and tools needed to respond.

Erneut Bombendrohungen gegen Schulen in Italien
Stand: 12.11.2026 • 15:25 Uhr
In Italien sind erneut Bombendrohungen an Schulen gesendet worden. Es sollen etwa 1.600 Einrichtungen betroffen sein. Die Regierung will Gebäude künftig nur noch räumen lassen, wenn konkrete Hinweise auf eine Gefahr vorliegen.
Hunderte Schulen in Italien haben erneut Bombendrohungen per E-Mail erhalten. Einige Bildungseinrichtungen wurden Medienberichten zufolge evakuiert. Die Regierung von Ministerpräsidentin Giorgia Meloni hat jedoch nach eigenen Angaben über die zuständigen Ministerien die lokalen Behörden und jeweiligen Schulleitungen darüber informiert, dass der Schulbetrieb regulär fortgesetzt werden soll.
Bereits am Mittwoch hatten etwa 6.000 Schulen solche Droh-E-Mails erhalten. Heute gingen nach Angaben der Nachrichtenagentur Ansa bei etwa 1.800 Einrichtungen Drohungen ein. Auffällige Funde gab es in den betroffenen Schulen aber nicht.

Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations.
Some 1,800 schools, from Milan in the north to Sicily in the south, reported receiving a similar threat to one that created chaos in Italy on Wednesday - even though no devices have been found anywhere.
The Italian government has advised schools that "in the absence of concrete evidence beyond the simple receipt of a mass email indicating a danger, buildings must not not be evacuated".
Schools in Scotland and Northern Ireland received threats on Wednesday, too. It is unclear whether the incidents are connected.
On Thursday morning, a bomb alert at a Calais rail station delayed international and national train services in northern France.
The latest incidents follow a series of bomb hoaxes last week against airports and airlines in a number of European countries.

titulekPuvodni: Evropa v Dublinu poprvé jedná o vyjednavačích pro Putina
shrnuti: Evropští lídři míří do Irska na dva dny summitů, jimž opět dominuje ruská válka, která tak v programu odsunula níž jednání o umělé inteligenci.

vyrez.text:
Evropa v Dublinu poprvé jedná o vyjednavačích pro Putina — Deník N
Budovy v dublinském přístavu, v nichž se konají summity EPS a EU. Foto: EU
Evropští lídři míří do Irska na dva dny summitů, jimž opět dominuje ruská válka, která tak v programu odsunula níž jednání o umělé inteligenci.
Více o poslechu Deníku N
Přidat Deník N mezi oblíbené zdroje
Článek vyšel v EUobserveru.
Dnes Dublin (hlavní město země, která v tomto půlroce předsedá Radě EU) vítá zhruba 55 lídrů členských zemí Evropského politického společenství (EPS) a zítra hostí neformální summit 27 lídrů států EU.
EPS vzniklo v reakci na plnou invazi Ruska na Ukrajinu v roce 2022 a kromě EU zahrnuje spojence z NATO Island, Turecko, Norsko a Spojené království, stejně jako Ukrajinu, Moldavsko, státy jižního Kavkazu a také balkánské země, které dosud nejsou členy Unie.

Igen i dag er skoler over hele Italien blevet evakueret efter at have modtaget mails med bombetrusler. Billedet her er fra Venedig i går, hvor mange italienske skoler lukkede af samme årsag. (Foto: © Andrea Merola, EPA/Ritzau Scanpix)

En række italienske skoler er igen i dag blevet evakueret efter at have modtaget mails med bombetrusler.
Det skriver det italienske nyhedsbureau Ansa.
Den italienske regering har netop meddelt, at omkring 1.800 italienske skoler i dag har modtaget bombetrusler. 
Truslerne er sendt til skoler over hele landet - blandt andet til skoler i regionerne Ligurien, Umbrien og i hovedstaden Rom.
Det er anden dag i streg, at italienske skoler modtager bombetrusler. 
I går modtog skoler i Irland, Nordirland og Skotland også bombetrusler. I alle tre lande opfattede politiets mailsene som fupnumre, men valgte alligevel at evakuere en del skoler.

Poľsko na poslednú chvíľu odvrátilo digitálny kolaps štátnej správy. Zahraniční útočníci cielili na celoštátnu platformu ePUAP, cez ktorú Poliaci komunikujú s úradmi, s plánom vyradiť ju z prevádzky.

titulekPuvodni: 'No light, no water, no heat': Ukrainians struggle with blackouts as Russia hits power grid
shrnuti: For parents in parts of Ukraine, trying to lead a normal family life with just a few hours of power each day is taking its toll.

vyrez.text:
Ukraine's power supply close to critical as Russian strikes bring darkness and cold - BBC News
Figure caption, Watch: Life in the darkness during Ukraine's blackouts
By Dan Johnson Reporting from Kyiv
Published
12 November 2026, 05:59 GMT
Updated 8 hours ago
Daryna Kulchytska is a mum under pressure. A single parent in a seventh floor flat in Kyiv trying to feed two lively kids and ensure they do their homework. But Daryna also faces the added strain of a deadline she can't even be certain of.
All she knows is soon the lights will go out, the sockets will lose power, the wi-fi will drop, and the taps will run dry. Tonight, the electricity has kept flowing an hour longer than advertised, but Daryna's still racing to serve dinner and finish her own work from home.
"The last few days it was only four or five hours we had power, but it's not at the same times. For two hours we have electricity, then for eight hours we don't."

titulek: Russian colonel killed in car explosion in St. Petersburg
titulekPuvodni: Russian colonel killed in car explosion in St. Petersburg
shrnuti: A car exploded in St. Petersburg’s Shushary district, killing a Russian colonel who was behind the wheel. The blast occurred on Kolpinskoye Highway.

vyrez.text:
Russian colonel killed in car explosion in St. Petersburg — Meduza
Skip to main content
Russian colonel killed in car explosion in St. Petersburg
November 12, 2026, 7:55 am
Source: Fontanka
A car exploded in St. Petersburg’s Shushary district, killing a Russian colonel who was behind the wheel. The blast occurred on Kolpinskoye Highway.
The explosive device had been attached to the underside of the car and detonated as the colonel was pulling out of a courtyard, according to the St. Petersburg-based news outlet Fontanka. The serviceman died.
Traffic on Kolpinskoye Highway near the blast site has been shut down.
A car carrying a lieutenant colonel and his wife exploded on Kolpinskoye Highway on August 27. The serviceman died. His wife survived. An explosive device had been attached to the underside of the car. Fontanka, a St. Petersburg-based news outlet, citing sources, reported that a 24-year-old Russian woman who left for Turkey after the blast is suspected of planting the bomb in the car. Law enforcement agencies have not officially commented on the progress of the investigation.

Ukraine’s armed forces is carrying out a massive, hours-long drone attack on Omsk.
Omsk Governor Vitaliy Khotsenko declared a drone threat alert on November 11 at 12:40 p.m. Moscow time. It remained in effect as of 8:10 p.m. Moscow time. Six hours into the attack, Khotsenko urged residents to stay indoors.

The targets and aftermath of the attack remain unconfirmed. Citing eyewitnesses, local Telegram channels reported that a fire broke out at the Omsk oil refinery and that a power plant may also have been damaged.
It is the second time since the war in Ukraine began that authorities have also declared a drone threat…

Bombendrohungen an 6.000 Schulen in Italien
Stand: 11.11.2026 • 16:31 Uhr
An Tausenden Schulen in Italien sind per E-Mail Bombendrohungen eingegangen. Auch in Großbritannien gibt es ähnliche Fälle. Die Behörden gehen von Falschmeldungen aus. Wer hinter den Drohungen steckt, ist unklar.
Etwa 6.000 Schulen in Italien haben E-Mails mit Bombendrohungen erhalten. Die Regierung gab inzwischen Entwarnung: Italiens Ministerpräsidentin Giorgia Meloni betonte, nach den bisher durchgeführten Überprüfungen gebe es keinerlei Hinweise auf eine konkrete Gefahr. Vorsorglich waren nach Regierungsangaben dennoch mindestens 300 Schulen evakuiert worden.
Von den Behörden gab es zunächst keine Angaben zu möglichen Hintergründen der Bombendrohungen. Meloni schrieb auf Facebook von einer "Strategie, die darauf abzielt, Beunruhigung und Sorge zu schüren". Sie kündigte eine umfassende Untersuchung der Vorfälle an und berief eine Krisensitzung der Regierung ein.

Unmanned aerial vehicles attacked the Omsk Oil Refinery, Russia's largest oil refining facility, on the evening of 11 November.
Source: The Moscow Times , an independent Amsterdam-based news outlet; Ukrainian monitoring channel Exilenova+
Details: Local residents reported that the facility had been hit and described loud explosions that rattled windows in residential buildings. The drone attack and explosions continued for more than two hours.
Advertisement:





Mina Akhverdieva, a spokesperson for the governor, said mobile coverage and internet access had been restricted in Omsk. Air-raid sirens sounded across the city, and the local airport suspended arrivals and departures.
The Omsk Oil Refinery is owned by Kremlin-controlled Gazprom Neft and is Russia's largest refinery, with a design capacity of 22 million tonnes of oil a year.
Official data indicates that the refinery supplies fuel to Russian forces and produces one in every six litres of petrol and diesel that meet Russia's K5 environmental standard.

shrnuti: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.

vyrez.text:
Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough - BBC News
Image source, Reuters
Image caption, On Thursday Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will travel to Moscow and Dublin to hold talks with the Russian and Ukrainian presidents
By Laura Gozzi
Published
57 minutes ago
Trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the US aimed at ending the war in Ukraine have concluded after a second day.
Although the American side said they saw "some openings", there was no hint of any breakthroughs to end the nearly five year-long war sparked by Russia's invasion.
Davyd Arakhamia from Ukraine's negotiating team said that this round of talks - the first since February - "was one of the hardest."
"I believe the Russians came with very strict directives, so it was extremely difficult to soften the discussion," he said. But he added that he felt "good momentum" and urged for a second round of talks to be organised as soon as possible.
Both Moscow and Kyiv confirmed that a large-scale prisoner of war exchange was in the works and could be carried out soon.

Russia on Wednesday rejected allegations that it was connected to a U.S. Army soldier who was arrested in the United Kingdom on suspicion of espionage.
British counterterrorism police arrested the 41-year-old senior U.S. soldier on Tuesday near the city of Gloucester in southwestern England following a joint investigation with the FBI and U.S. Army counterintelligence.
He was arrested under two sections of the U.K. National Security Act, which pertain to obtaining or disclosing protected information and assisting a foreign intelligence service. The law allows counterterrorism police to hold him without charge for up to 14 days.
British law enforcement said the country to which the allegations relate is Russia.

Ruský prezident Vladimir Putin je otvorený potenciálnym kontaktom s európskymi predstaviteľmi, aj s nemeckým kancelárom Friedrichom Merzom. Uviedol to v stredu hovorca Kremľa Dmitrij Peskov, píše TASR na základe správy agentúry TASS.
Merz tento týždeň podľa denníka Westfalenpost povedal, že by sa nevyhýbal stretnutiu s Putinom počas summitu G20 v Miami.
